title: Gram matrix certificate
description: Output of `hecke-gram` — the 6x6 Gram matrix of H_3(q) on the NF basis, its inverse ON THE QUOTIENT H_3(q)/rad, the null direction, and the Markov trace weights, at a given q. Under convention D the form is singular (corank 1, the three-strand q-antisymmetriser), so there is no 6x6 inverse and the certificate does not offer one.

quotient_inverse.description: Moore-Penrose inverse of `matrix`, which for a symmetric form with a one-dimensional kernel IS the inverse on the orthogonal complement of that kernel — i.e. on the quotient H_3(q)/rad. RENAMED from `inverse` (2026-08-15) when convention D made the 6x6 inverse nonexistent; the rename is deliberate so a consumer keyed on the old name fails loudly rather than silently receiving a matrix that differs exactly on the radical.

radical.description: The null direction of `matrix`, in closed form: the three-strand q-antisymmetriser (-1/q)^len(w) over the NF basis. Verified exactly over Q at n = 3, 4, 5 in computations/probes/gram_radical_cellular_revalidation.py.

determinant.description: Determinant of `matrix`. Under convention D this is ZERO exactly (proved over Q(q)); a nonzero value here is f64 noise, not a resolved determinant.
